picks.title: VoiceStudio: open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative with voice cloning, dubbing and dictation in 646 languages
picks.summary: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice AI studio: voice cloning from a 3-second sample, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation in 646 languages. Ships via Docker with an official Google Colab notebook for zero-install use.
picks.implementation_idea: A media or education startup can run privacy-safe voice cloning and multilingual video dubbing on its own servers, generating localized audiobooks or course narration in dozens of languages with no per-minute API cost.
picks.gist: Clone voices, dub videos, and transcribe in 646 languages entirely on your own machine.
picks.analogy: Like a recording studio that fits in your laptop and needs no internet.
picks.why: Trending first on GitHub at 50,849 stars: cloning and dubbing without uploading audio or paying monthly.

picks.title: Paperclip: the app people use to manage agents at work
picks.summary: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents: org charts, budgets, governance, heartbeats and a ticket system in one dashboard.
picks.implementation_idea: A small company running several AI agents can organize them like a team, with roles, token budgets and approval gates before any agent spends money or ships changes.
picks.gist: One dashboard to assign work to your AI helpers, watch their spending, and keep them in line.
picks.analogy: Like an HR system but for managing AI workers instead of people.
picks.why: 95494 stars and #1 GitHub trending today as teams manage digital workers.

picks.title: OmniRoute
picks.summary: Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers and 500+ models with quota-aware auto-fallback.
picks.implementation_idea: A startup calling several AI providers can route everything through one free gateway, so when a provider fails or hits its quota, requests fall back to another automatically.
picks.gist: Talk to 500+ AI models from one free doorway, and it switches providers when limits hit.
picks.analogy: Like a universal power adapter that always finds a working outlet.
picks.why: Free and already 71,872 stars: a ready way to cut AI bills without switching tools.
